AboutResourcesDesc: Explore project source code, install server plugins, access quick issue reporting, join Discord, or support development.
AboutTabDescription: View application version, platform specifications, and hardware identity.
AccountTabDescription: Manage active user sessions, switch profiles, configure security PINs, and sign out.
AllowedAudioChannelsDescription: Configure maximum audio channels for video playback.
AlphaPickerPositionDescription: Choose the layout and placement of the alphabet quick-jump selector in library views.
AlphaPickerScrollModeDescription: In unlimited mode, scroll directly to letter sections instead of filtering the library.
AppDescription: A lightweight, community-driven Jellyfin client built with love for speed and simplicity.
AppFontDescription: Choose the typeface used throughout the app
AppLanguageDescription: Choose the language used throughout the app (requires restart)
AssDropAnimationsDescription: Skip animated effects for better performance on slow TVs, might cause some subtitles to render incorrectly
AssPrescaleFactorDescription: Lower = better performance but softer text (1.0 = full resolution).
AssRendererDescription: Choose the rendering engine for ASS/SSA subtitle styling.
AudioLanguageFallbackDescription: Used when your preferred language is not in the media. Tries 1, then 2, then 3.
AutoPlayNextDescription: Automatically play next episode when current ends
AutoRefreshRateDescription: Automatically matches TV / HDMI display refresh rate (e.g. 24Hz, 50Hz, 60Hz) to video frame rate to eliminate judder.
AutoTranscodeOnErrorDescription: Automatically escalate to server-side transcoding if DirectPlay or Remux fails during playback startup or mid-stream.
AutoUpdateCheckDesc: Notify me when a new version is available on GitHub.
AwaitTracksBeforePlaybackDescription: Fully await audio and subtitle tracks to load before starting playback and hiding the loading screen. could increase initial loading time significantly for some files.
BackdropDimmerDescription: How dark the backdrop screensaver should be
BackdropHideTextDescription: Do not show any text over the backdrop screensaver images
BackdropIncludeMusicDescription: Show backdrops from music artists in the screensaver
BackupDescription: Synchronise your application settings and preferences across all your devices by backing them up to your Jellyfin server.
BackupFailed: Backup failed. Please verify plugin connectivity.
BackUpNowDescription: Uploads your current preferences and player settings to the Jellyfin server.
BackupPluginError: Server backup plugin is not available. Please ensure the Litefin plugin is installed on your Jellyfin server.
BadgeStyleDescription: Select the appearance of media poster badges (unplayed counts, play checkmarks, quality labels, etc.).
BorderOpacityDescription: Opacity of the sharp text border
BorderWidthDescription: Width of the sharp text border
BottomNavBarColorDescription: Choose the background transparency or style for the mobile bottom navigation bar.
ButtonStyleDescription: Customise the look and focus style of primary buttons.
CardLabelAlignDescription: Choose how titles and subtitles are aligned under media cards.
CardLabelScaleDescription: Adjust the text size of titles and subtitles under media cards.
CardLabelStyleDescription: Choose how the title and subtitle are displayed under media cards.
CardSizeScaleDescription: Adjust the size of horizontal row items (posters, landscape, etc..), please note that the bigger this size is the worse the performance will get (Requires Restart).
CheckForUpdatesDesc: Trigger a manual check for new releases on GitHub.
ClearAllCachesDescription: Removes all non-essential cached data. Will not sign you out.
ClearDebugFiltersDescription: Removes stored filter settings for deleted or renamed modules.
ClearImageCacheDescription: Removes cached library thumbnail URLs. Safe — does not affect settings or auth.
CollapsedSidebarColorDescription: Choose the background transparency or style for the collapsed sidebar.
CompanionPluginsDesc: Server plugins for Jellyfin and Emby providing Seerr integrations and settings backup.
ConfirmAppExitDescription: Show a confirmation prompt before closing the application.
ConfirmAppExitMessage: Are you sure you want to exit Litefin?
ConfirmExitPlayerDescription: Show a confirmation dialog when pressing back to prevent accidentally closing playback.
ConfirmExitPlayerMessage: Are you sure you want to stop playback and exit?
ConfirmSeekWithOKDescription: While scrolling the timeline, show the preview and apply the new position only when OK is pressed.
ConnectionErrorMessage:
We couldn't connect to {0}.
Check if your server is running or try another one.
ControlsTabDescription: Map physical remote buttons, mouse cursor behaviour, and navigation gestures.
DebugTabDescription: Inspect developer metrics, view performance stats, test logs, and capture crash reports.
DefaultLibraryColumnsDescription: Choose the default number of items displayed per row across libraries.
DefaultLibraryViewModeDescription: Choose the default view layout for libraries that do not have a custom view mode configured.
DefaultLiveTvTabDescription: Choose which tab is selected by default when opening the Live TV page.
DeleteBackupDescription: Completely remove the settings backup from the Jellyfin server.
DeleteBackupWarning: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your settings backup from the server?
DeleteMediaConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this item from your library and storage? This action cannot be undone.
DetailsAlwaysShowSeeMoreDescription: Always display the Detailed View button on details and person pages even if the description fits without truncation.
DetailsImageQualityDescription: Set the image quality specifically for the item details page. High quality is recommended for a premium feel.
DetailsOverviewMaxLinesDescription: Configure the maximum number of lines for overviews and biographies on details and person pages.
DetailsTitleStyleDescription: Choose how the title and logo/icon are displayed on the details page.
DisableBlurHashDescription: Stop showing colour-accurate blurred backgrounds while images are loading. Uses standard dark skeletons instead.
DisableCardScalingDescription: Stop movie posters and thumbnails from scaling up when focused. Helpful for grid stability.
DisableFocusRestoreDescription: Skip saving and restoring the last focused item when navigating between pages to reduce memory usage. Focus will reset to the first item on each page.
DisableLibraryBlurHashDescription: Stop decoding and displaying BlurHash placeholder canvases in library grids. Uses standard dark skeletons instead to maximise navigation and scroll performance on low-power TVs.
DisableLibraryCacheDescription: Skip caching library content (items, filters, sort) when navigating away. The library will reload from the server on every visit. Saves memory at the cost of slower navigation.
DisableSidebarAnimationDescription: Sidebar will open and close instantly without animation.
DisableVbrAudioEncodingHelp: Prevent the server from encoding audio with VBR for this client.
DiscordCommunityDesc: Join the official community for real-time discussion, troubleshooting, and announcements.
DisplayScaleDescription: Adjust overall interface scaling. "Auto" dynamically fits the layout to 1080p canvas proportions.
DisplayTabDescription: Customise themes, accent colours, icons, interface scaling, and display behaviour.
DolbyVisionDescription: Enable DV if your TV supports it (auto-detected)
DownloadingArtwork: Downloading and saving artwork to server...
DTSPassthroughDescription: ⚠ Doesn't work on WebOS even with external audio receiver. Only works on Tizen with external audio receiver through eARC HDMI sometimes.
EmulatorExitConfirm: Are you sure you want to exit? Make sure you have saved your game progress.
EnableAssStyleModificationsDescription: When disabled, ASS subtitles render with their original embedded styles (font, outline, shadow, scaling, and spacing are all kept as-authored).
EnableAudioOffloadDescription: Directs audio decoding to the dedicated hardware DSP to reduce CPU power consumption and prevent audio stalls.
EnableBackgroundServiceDescription: Enable the background Node.js service for discovery and proxy playback features.
EnableCollectionRows: Enable Collection Rows in Home Screen
EnableCollectionRowsDescription: Display custom collection and trending rows on the home screen.
EnableDebugLogsDescription: Allow application to output logs to console
EnableEAC3Description: ⚠ Use when EAC3 sources transcode unnecessarily. Overrides the browser/hardware probe. Enable if your TV passes EAC3 through eARC but the app still transcodes it.
EnableExoPlayerDebugLogsDescription: Output low-level Media3 ExoPlayer playback and state events to the console.
EnableFmp4HlsContainerDescription: Advertise fMP4 (ISOBMFF) HLS transcoding profiles. Unlocks HEVC/AV1 remuxing on supported hardware.
EnableHeroCarouselDescription: Display an auto-scrolling hero section at the top of the home screen.
EnableHoverTrickplayDescription: Show timestamp and trickplay images when hovering over the seekbar with the mouse.
EnableMoviDebugLogsDescription: Output low-level WebAssembly demuxer, FFmpeg, and decoding logs from movi-player to the logger.
EnableMP2Description: ⚠ Use to override browser/hardware MP2 audio support detection. Disable to force server transcoding (avoids TV stalls).
EnablePlayerCursor: Enable Cursor Controls inside the player
EnablePlayerCursorDescription: Allow cursor/mouse interaction within the player (clicking to pause, waking the OSD on move).
EnableScreenLockDescription: Enable a screen and input lock button in the player overlay.
EnableSeekAccelerationDescription: Ramp up seeking speed progressively (up to 10x) the longer seek directional buttons are held.
EnableTrickplayDescription: Show video frame previews when scrubbing through the timeline
EnableTunnelingDescription: Enables hardware A/V clock tunnelling in ExoPlayer for reduced CPU jitter on supported devices (e.g. Nvidia Shield). Keep disabled if experiencing a black screen or audio stuttering.
ErrorApplyingMetadata: Failed to apply metadata to item
ErrorDownloadingImage: Failed to download image from provider
ExpandedSidebarColorDescription: Choose the background transparency or style for the expanded sidebar.
FavoriteLanguagesDescription: Limit language dropdowns and media tracks across the app to your favourite languages.
FLACPassthroughDescription: Allow FLAC audio tracks in video files to play directly. Disable if you hear audio/video sync issues (~2s delay). Does not affect FLAC music files.
FocusBorderStyleDescription: Customise the border colour style when buttons are focused.
FocusFirstItemInLibraryDescription: Automatically focus the first item when entering a library instead of the navigation tabs.
FontFamilyAssDescription: Force overrides font for ASS/SSA subs
ForceDirectPlayAudioOnly: Force Direct Play Audio Codecs Only
ForceDirectPlayDescription: Forces direct play for all media formats. May cause playback failure if the device does not support the format natively.
ForceDirectPlayVideoOnly: Force Direct Play Video Codecs Only
ForceFmp4HlsContainerDescription: ⚠ Use fMP4 as the primary container, bypassing hardware version gates. May cause playback failure on older TVs.
ForceTranscodeDescription: Emergency fallback — forces ALL content to transcode via HLS
ForgetServerConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to forget this server? All user sessions on this server will be removed and you will need to re-enter your credentials to return.
GitHubRepoDesc: View source code, release notes, documentation, and project updates on GitHub.
HDRDescription: Pass HDR content to the display without transcoding
HeroCarouselBlurhashFillDescription: Fill the rest of the hero carousel background with ambient colours extracted from the artwork BlurHash.
HeroCarouselCompactDescription: Reduces the height of the hero section to improve scroll performance.
HeroCarouselCountDescription: Choose how many items to load in the hero carousel (1-10).
HeroCarouselIgnoreWatchedDescription: Excludes already watched movies and series from appearing in the featured carousel.
HeroCarouselIndicatorAnimationDescriptio: Enable the progress bar animation for the carousel dots.
HeroCarouselIndicatorStyleDescription: Visual style of the hero carousel position indicators.
HeroCarouselIntervalDescription: Customise how long each hero slide stays on screen before switching.
HeroCarouselMdbListDescription: Display premium ratings (IMDb, RT, Trakt, etc.) directly on the home carousel items.
HeroCarouselTextTitleDescription: Prefer text titles over logos in the hero carousel.
HeroCarouselVignetteDescription: Adjust the darkness of the text contrast vignette behind hero titles for maximum readability.
HeroCarouselZoomDescription: Enable the slow background motion effect on the hero carousel backdrops.
HeroImageQualityDescription: Set the image quality specifically for hero backgrounds. Lower quality can improve performance.
HeroStyleDescription: Visual style of the hero carousel
HideCastSectionDescription: Hide the actors and guest stars rows on the details page.
HideEpisodeCountsDescription: Hide the unplayed episode count badge on series and season cards
HideGhostModeDescription: Hide the ghost mode (incognito play) button on the item details page.
HideLibraryLabelsDescription: Hide the text label beneath library cards on the home screen
HideLiveTvInMyMedia: Hide Live TV from My Media
HideLiveTvInMyMediaDescription: Hide the Live TV library card from the 'My Media' row on the home screen
HideNextUpSectionDescription: Do not load or display the Next Up row on the details page.
HideOriginalTitleDescription: Do not show the original language title under the main title on the details page.
HideProgressBarDescription: Hide playback progress indicators on media cards
HideShowNameInOsdDescription: Hides the show name (or logo) for episodes in the playback overlay.
HideSidebarLibraryHeaderDescription: Hide the "My Media" library group title and its divider spacing in the sidebar.
HideSimilarSectionDescription: Do not load or display the similar recommendations section on the details page.
HideUnfocusedBordersDescription: Hide borders on buttons when they are not focused.
HideWatchedContentFromLatestMediaDescrip: Hide watched content from Recently Added Media
HideYearInOsdDescription: Hides the production year from the playback overlay title.
HomeForceExpandablePostersDescription: Force all media rows (except My Media in home screen) to use portrait posters that expand horizontally on focus.
HomeRowsLimitDescription: Maximum number of items displayed per row on the home screen.
HomeScreenCacheDescription: Skip caching home screen data between pages. The home screen will reload from the server on every visit. Saves memory at the cost of slower back-navigation.
HomeTabDescription: Manage home screen sections, featured hero carousel, and content row limits.
HorizontalScrollModeDescription: Choose how horizontal media row scrolling is animated (GPU Accelerated, Smooth, or Instant).
HoverBorderStyleDescription: Customise the border colour style when buttons are hovered.
HoverScrollNavigationDescription: Traverse vertical lists and rows using the scroll wheel or magic remote wheel.
Html5MaxBufferLengthDesc: Maximum length of video to keep in the forward buffer (seconds).
Html5MaxMaxBufferLengthDesc: Maximum length of video buffer allowed when bitrates are low.
IconStyleDescription: Choose a visual style theme for icons across the app.
IconVariantDescription: Select whether icons should be outlined, filled, or change dynamically based on focus state.
IncludeCurrentEpisodeInMoreFromSeason: Include Current Episode in More From Season Row and focus on it
IncludeCurrentEpisodeInMoreFromSeasonDes: Include the currently playing/opened episode in the 'More From Season' row on the details page, and focus on it.
InitialSidebarFocusDescription: Select which item gets focused first when opening the sidebar.
InterlacedBackendFallbackDescription: When AVPlay is active, automatically switch to the HTML5 player for interlaced video (1080i). No re-encoding — Chromium decodes it natively.
JellyfinFallbackFontSelectionDescription: Select which font file on the server to use as the fallback font
KeepFocusOnSubtitleOffsetDescription: Remember focus position on the subtitle offset menu when the player controls auto-hide.
KeepSidebarNavButtonDescription: Do not hide the Home or Settings button from the navigation list when the logo is mapped to it.
LabelCustomCollectionRowsDesc: Select which collections to display as dedicated rows on your Home screen.
LabelInstantPlaybackDescription: Pre-fetches stream information in the background on details page for zero-latency start.
LabelMergeResumeNextUpDescription: Combine in-progress items and next episodes into a single row on the home screen.
LabelOnlyBlurHashBackdrop: Only Use BlurHash for Details Backdrop
LabelOsdHideUnfocusedProgress: Hide Progress and Time on Seekbar
LabelResetSettingsDescription: Restore all application and player settings to their default values. This will not sign you out.
LabelResetUserToGlobalDescription: Discard all custom settings for this profile and copy the current global settings.
LabelSecondaryTitleSecondaryColor: Use Secondary Colour for Episode Info
LabelTrendingMoviesCollectionDescription: Select the collection or playlist that feeds the Trending Movies row.
LabelTrendingSeriesCollectionDescription: Select the collection or playlist that feeds the Trending Series row.
LabelUseTrendingCollectionNameDescriptio: Display the collection or playlist name instead of 'Trending Movies' / 'Trending Series' on the home screen.
LayoutDirectionDescription: Force the application's text reading direction (requires restart)
LayoutTabDescription: Configure page structures, login and details layouts, and UI component alignments.
LibrariesAdminDescription: Manage server media libraries, trigger global library scans, and refresh metadata.
LibraryPageSizeDescription: Choose how many items to load at once in the grid view. Low values improve performance on weaker devices.
LibraryScanQueued: Library scan queued for all libraries.
LibraryThumbnailsDescription: Style of library cards on the home screen
LighterBackgroundDescription: Swap the primary background with the alternate background for a lighter shade.
LightMusicPlayerDescription: Removes heavy blur and shadow effects from the music player for smoother performance on older TVs
LitefinPluginMissingDesc: Litefin companion plugin is not installed on the Jellyfin server. Seerr integration, batch queries, and server backups are disabled.
LoaderStyleDescription: Choose the visual animation style for loading spinners and indicators across the app.
LoaderStyleDotsDesc: Signature multi-dot animation with vibrant theme glow.
LoaderStyleDottedRingDesc: Dual-ring concentric spinner featuring dotted and solid accent strokes.
LoaderStyleDualRingDesc: Concentric rotating ring with accent outer arc.
LoaderStyleEclipseSweepDesc: Heavy Animation !! - Minimalist circular disc illuminated by a traveling inset crescent shadow.
LoaderStyleHorizontalDotsDesc: Heavy Animation !! - Horizontal linear dot triad with progressive wave pulse animations.
LoaderStyleOrbitDesc: Translucent circular path with an orbiting accent satellite point.
LoaderStylePulsingGridDesc: Heavy Animation !! - Geometric four-quadrant pinwheel that contracts, rotates, and expands.
LoaderStylePushPulseDesc: Heavy Animation !! - Interlocking dual spheres expanding and contracting in counter-phase rhythm.
LoaderStyleRingDesc: Lightweight circular ring with minimal GPU & CPU overhead.
LoaderStyleSatelliteDesc: Rotating primary accent frame with an offset secondary orbiting ring.
LoaderStyleSonarRingDesc: Spinning theme-coloured disc with opposing high-contrast aperture cutouts.
LoaderStyleTripleRingDesc: Multi-tier concentric arcs spinning in alternating counter directions.
LoginPageLayoutDescription: Choose the layout mode for the login pages (Requires restart).
LogoSettingsDescription: Choose how the top sidebar logo behaves and what buttons are visible.
LoopOverflowingTextDescription: Loop title and subtitle text horizontally on focus if they are too long to fit.
LowVramModeDescription: Disable GPU-intensive animations and transitions to prevent rendering glitches on older hardware.
MaxDaysForNextUpDescription: Set the maximum number of days a show should stay in the 'Next Up' list without watching it.
MaxResolutionDescription: Override panel detection (Auto uses hardware APIs)
MediaRowsLayoutDescription: Choose the layout mode for horizontal media rows (Requires restart).
MissingServerPluginMessage: '{0}' requires the '{1}' plugin to be installed and enabled on your Jellyfin server. Please install it via the Jellyfin dashboard and try again.
MobileFullscreenDescription: Hide status and navigation bars on mobile devices for an edge-to-edge layout. When disabled, system bars remain visible in safe zone. Video playback always remains in fullscreen.
MovieDetailsLayoutDescription: Choose the layout mode for movies and series details pages.
Name: Name
NextUpDialogScaleDescription: Adjust the overall scaling factor of the next episode dialog.
NextUpDialogStyleDescription: Choose the layout style of the next episode dialog.
NextUpTriggerModeDescription: Choose when the next episode card should appear.
NoBackupFound: No settings backup for this user found on the server.
NoCurrentImageSet: No image currently set for this type.
NoCustomHeadersConfigured: No custom headers configured. Use a preset above or click Add Header to start.
NoFavoritesFound: No favourites found. Go add some!
NoItemsFoundDescription: Try adjusting your filters or search to find what you're looking for.
NoLibraries: No libraries found. Please check your Jellyfin user permissions.
NoRemoteImagesFound: No remote provider images found for this type.
OkShowOsdOnlyDescription: When the player controls are hidden, pressing OK will only show them instead of also running the focused action.
OnlyBlurHashBackdropDescription: Use only the lightweight decoded colour blurhash as the details page background. Not only does it look cool, it also Does not fetch or load the heavy high-resolution backdrop image, saving network bandwidth and GPU VRAM.
OsdButtonShapeDescription: Choose a custom shape for the player control buttons.
OsdButtonsLocationDescription: Choose the location of playback control buttons relative to the seek bar.
OsdButtonStyleDescription: Choose a button colour theme specifically for player control buttons.
OsdColorButtonsRevealDescription: Allow pressing coloured remote buttons (Red, Green, Yellow, Blue) to instantly reveal controls in stealth mode instead of holding Down.
OsdCombineSkipButtonsDescription: Combine seek, chapter, and file skip buttons. Click once to seek, twice for chapters, three times for files.
OsdFocusBorderStyleDescription: Choose a focus border highlight style specifically for player control buttons.
OsdFocusRestoreModeDescription: Where the remote focus lands when the player controls reappear after being auto-hidden.
OsdGradientOpacityDescription: Adjust the opacity of the top and bottom dark gradient overlays on the player.
OsdHdrDarkerWhiteDescription: Override white OSD elements with a softer dark grey inside HDR content to prevent eye strain.
OsdHideBackButtonDescription: Hide the back arrow button from the player OSD.
OsdHideFavoriteDescription: Hide the favourite heart button from the player OSD.
OsdHideInfoDescription: Hide the playback details / description button from the player OSD.
OsdHideUnfocusedProgressDescription: Hides the progress bar, times, and ends-at time when the seekbar is not focused. When focused, values are shown normally. Note: If OSD Focus Mode is set to 'Always return to Seekbar', this setting will not work because the seekbar is always focused.
OsdLayoutDescription: Choose the layout alignment of player playback and menu control buttons.
OsdLogoSizeDescription: Choose the display size of the show or movie logo in the playback overlay.
OsdSeekBarProgressColorDescription: Choose the colour for the seek bar progress fill.
OsdSeekBarThumbColorDescription: Choose the colour for the seek bar thumb.
OsdTimeDisplayDescription: Choose whether to show the total duration or remaining time on the player seek bar.
OsdTrackMenuBgOpacityDescription: Adjust the background opacity of all player menus and overlay panels.
OsdUnfocusedButtonStyleDescription: Choose the style of player control buttons when they are not focused.
OverlayHeightDescription: Vertical size of the debug window
OverlayPositionDescription: Screen location of the debug window
OverlayWidthDescription: Horizontal size of the debug window
OverrideAssFontsDescription: Override container-embedded ASS fonts with your chosen font or system fallback.
OverrideOutlineShadowDescription: Enable user settings for text border and shadow depth (disabling this uses values from the file)
OverrideThemeColorDescription: Replace the theme colour with this theme's own unique signature colour.
PausePlaybackOnScrubDescription: Pause playback when scrubbing the seek bar and resume when finished.
PCMPassthroughDescription: Force uncompressed PCM audio tracks in video files to play directly on Tizen AVPlay. Disabled by default because most Samsung TVs fail to decode raw PCM in video containers.
PerformanceTabDescription: Optimise memory usage, scrolling animations, cache policies, and rendering speed.
PgsModeClient: Client Rendering (Web Worker, Smooth TV UI)
PgsOpacityHdrDescription: Subtitle transparency for image-based (PGS) subtitles in HDR
PgsOpacitySdrDescription: Subtitle transparency for image-based (PGS) subtitles in SDR
PgsPlaybackModeDescription: Choose how graphic subtitles (PGS/VOBSUB) are handled.
PlaybackTabDescription: Configure video quality, audio streams, playback compatibility, and player behaviour.
PlayNextUpDialogDescription: Show the countdown dialog for the next episode before the current one ends
PlayQueueEpisodeLimitDescription: Number of previous and next episodes to load into the player queue around the active episode. Lower values reduce memory and improve performance on large series.
PlayThemeSongsDescription: Play show theme songs in the background when viewing details pages of TV Shows. This requires extra setting up in your server, either via themerr plugin or adding theme.mp3 manually for each show
PlayThemeSongsOnceDescription: Play background theme songs only once instead of looping continuously.
PluginsTabDescription: Extend functionality with community add-ons, metadata providers, and third-party integrations.
PreferBackdropsOverThumbsDescription: Prefer backdrop artwork over thumbnails for wide cards in Expanding and Expanded layouts.
PreferDirectPlayAudioDescription: Automatically select an audio track that plays directly without transcoding when the default track (e.g. TrueHD or DTS) is unsupported by hardware.
PreferEpisodeImagesDescription: Use episode thumbnails instead of series images for Next Up and Continue Watching rows.
PreferExternalSubtitlesDescription: When subtitles 'Always' mode is enabled, prefer external subtitle tracks (SRT/VTT) over embedded ones even if the language is undetermined.
PreventScreensaverOnPlaybackDescription: Keep display awake and suppress system screensaver while video is actively playing
ProxyAuthHeadersDesc: Configure proxy gateway headers (e.g. Cloudflare Zero Trust, Pangolin) for this Jellyfin server.
QuickConnectDescription: To sign in with Quick Connect, select the 'Quick Connect' button on the device you are logging in from and enter the displayed code below.
QuickConnectTimeout: Quick Connect timed out. Try again.
ReduceMotionLargeScrollsDescription: Instantly snap to the target instead of animating when scrolling long distances that would cause frame drops (improves performance).
RegenerateThumbnailsDescription: Pick new random thumbnails for libraries cards
ReloadOnResumeDescription: Automatically reload the active view when returning from background or waking from sleep. Keep disabled to preserve loaded lists and scroll position.
RememberLastActiveUserDescription: Automatically log in as the last active user on startup, bypassing the user selection screen.
RememberTracksForSessionDescription: Automatically carry your active audio and subtitle tracks to the next episode.
RemoteBlueActionDescription: Action to perform when the Blue button on the remote is pressed.
RemoteGreenActionDescription: Action to perform when the Green button on the remote is pressed.
RemoteRedActionDescription: Action to perform when the Red button on the remote is pressed.
RemoteYellowActionDescription: Action to perform when the Yellow button on the remote is pressed.
RemuxMkvToMp4Description: Always remux MKV containers to MP4. Streams are copied losslessly — no re-encoding. Off by default.
ReportIssueDesc: Scan to quickly report bugs, request features, or attach troubleshooting details.
RequirePinDescription: Ask for this profile's PIN before it can be selected on the sign-in screen.
ResetSeekSpeedOnDirectionChange: Reset seek speed on direction change
ResetSeekSpeedOnDirectionChangeDescripti: Reset accelerated seek speed back to 1x when reversing direction during timeline scrubbing.
ResetSettingsWarning: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to default? The application will reload to apply the changes.
ResetUserToGlobalWarning: This will permanently discard all custom preferences for this profile and copy the current global settings. The app will reload to apply the changes. Do you want to continue?
RestoreSettingsDescription: Restore settings from the server backup and reload the application.
RestoreSettingsWarning: Restoring settings will overwrite all your current preferences. The app will reload to apply the changes. Do you want to continue?
ResumeRewindDurationDescription: Rewind playback slightly when resuming an in-progress video to review the previous scene
RichMetadataStyleDescription: Customise which metadata fields (genres, studios, writers, directors, tags) are shown on the details page.
RoundedCornersDescription: Apply rounded corners to posters and UI elements
ScanAllLibrariesDescription: Trigger a comprehensive scan across all media libraries to discover newly added files.
ScanForNewAndUpdatedFiles: Scan for new and updated files
ScanNewUpdatedFiles: Scan for new and updated files
ScoreVisibilityDescription: Control how community and critic scores are displayed.
ScreensaverDelayDescription: When to display the screensaver while idle

ScrollSmoothingDurationDescription: Configure animation duration and speed for vertical row navigation.
SeasonEpisodeDetailsLayoutDescription: Choose the layout mode for season and episode details pages.
SecondaryTitleSecondaryColorDescription: Use the secondary text colour for the episode number and show name secondary title on the details page instead of the primary accent colour.
SeekWithArrowsDescription: When the player controls are hidden, pressing Left or Right will instantly seek instead of just showing the controls.
SeerrLoadFailed: Could not load content from Seerr.
SeerrNotConfigured: Seerr is not set up yet.
SeerrRecommendationsDescription: Show recommendations from Seerr on media details pages.
SeerrStatusConnectedDesc: Litefin companion plugin is active and successfully connected to Seerr.
SeerrStatusMissingDesc: Litefin companion plugin is active on the server, but Seerr integration is not configured.
SeerrStatusNotConfiguredDesc: Litefin companion plugin is active, but Seerr URL or API key is not configured in the plugin settings.
SeerrStatusPluginMissingDesc: Litefin companion plugin is not reachable on the Jellyfin server.

ShowCollapsedLibraryIconsDescription: Show library icons in the sidebar even when it is collapsed.

ShowDebugOverlayDescription: Display logs on screen (requires Debug Logs)
ShowFavoriteBadgesDescription: Display a heart badge on favourited media cards.
ShowLogoInOsdDescription: Display show or movie logo instead of text title in the player interface (if available).
ShowMdbAwardsDescription: Display award badges from MDBList plugin on the details page.
ShowMediaSourceCountsDescription: Display a badge showing the number of available video versions on media cards.

ShowQualityBadgesDescription: Display quality badges (e.g. 4K, 1080p, HDR) on media poster cards.

SidebarBackButtonDescription: Show a back button above the Litefin logo when navigating sub-pages.
SidebarIconShadowsDescription: Add shadows to all icons in the sidebar.
SidebarItemsAlignDescription: Choose the vertical alignment of items inside the sidebar.
SidebarLayoutDescription: Choose the layout mode for the navigation sidebar.
SidebarLogoColorDescription: Choose the colour for the sidebar Litefin logo.
SidebarModeDescription: Choose how the sidebar appears when collapsed.
SidebarSelectedColorDescription: Choose the colour for selected sidebar items.
SidebarTabDescription: Customise navigation bar layout, pin libraries, and manage sidebar shortcuts.
SidebarUnselectedColorDescription: Choose the colour for unselected sidebar items.
SkipBackDurationDescription: Seconds to skip when pressing back
SkipForwardDurationDescription: Seconds to skip when pressing forward

TimeFormatDescription: Choose how the clock and playback end times are displayed.

TizenInitialBufferDesc: Seconds of video to buffer before playback begins.

TranscodeAudioCodecDescription: When audio must be transcoded (e.g. DTS is unsupported), use this codec. E-AC3 is higher quality; AC3 has the widest legacy receiver support; AAC is the universal fallback.
TranscodeMaxAudioChannelsDescription: Maximum audio channels output by the server when audio is transcoded.
TranscodingSegmentLengthDesc: Length of HLS segments generated by the server. Only applied when the video is transcoded.
TrueHDPassthroughDescription: ⚠ Doesn't work on WebOS even with external audio receiver. Only works on Tizen with external audio receiver through eARC HDMI sometimes.

UploadLogsDescription: Send current session logs to the jellyfin server
UseBatchLatestPluginDescription: Fetch all home screen library rows in a single batched HTTP request via the Litefin plugin. Improves home page load speed.
UseEpisodeBadgesDescription: Display the episode SxxExx badge on media cards instead of prefixing the episode title.
UseItemsForSearchDescription: Query the /Items API instead of /Search/Hints for global search. Required by certain server plugins.
UseSeasonBadgesDescription: Display the season name/number badge on season cards.
VerticalScrollAlignmentDescription: Choose where focused rows align on screen (Bottom, Middle, or Top). Bottom reduces scroll frequency significantly.
VerticalScrollModeDescription: Choose how vertical page scrolling is animated (JS RAF, Native/Smooth, or GPU Accelerated).
ViewDeviceInfoDesc: Hardware model, platform specifications, screen resolution, and audio/video codec decoders.
VP9Description: Direct play VP9 content (WebM, YouTube-style files)
WakeOnLanExtendedWaitDescription: Increases server boot await timer from ~18s to ~90s (25 retry attempts) when starting up or connecting. Essential for PCs powering on from a cold shutdown state.
WakeOnLanServerScanDescription: Automatically send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to your saved server MAC address when scanning for local servers.
WakeOnLanStartupDescription: Send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to wake up the server when Litefin starts.
WakeOnLanTimeoutDescription: Automatically send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet and retry if a request times out or server goes offline.
WatchedThresholdDescription: Choose the playback completion percentage required to mark an item as watched and clear its resume point. Litefin defaults to 80% to accommodate credit and ending sequences, or you can respect your Jellyfin server setting.

WebosBufferGateDesc: Threshold in seconds for micro-stall recovery.
WebosStallRecoveryDesc: Timeout in milliseconds before a recovery kick is applied.
